title: Slovakian Hash with Scrambled Eggs
description: A hearty and flavorful breakfast dish inspired by Slovakian cuisine, featuring crispy hash browns and rich scrambled eggs.

ingredients.name: Hash browns
ingredients.notes: preferably leftover from the night before

instructions: Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add chopped shallots and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add chopped potatoes and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Push the hash browns to one side of the pan and crack in the eggs.
Scramble the eggs and mix with the hash browns.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
